LspPosition.description:
A position in a document: a zero-based line, and a zero-based column in
the position encoding the client and server agreed on.

character.description: The column, from 0, in the negotiated position encoding.

LspRange.description: A range in a document, from `start` up to (not including) `end`.

choices.description:
For a choice or a level, its values, in the order a message lists
them.

default.description: The value used when the file leaves it out, when it has one.

defaultText.description: The reference's words for a default that isn't one value.

description.description:
What it does, as plain text: the registry's Markdown with a link's
address dropped and its text kept, emphasis taken off, and code spans
as pieces of their own.

name.description: Its name for people: the key in words, `Trailing slash`.

problems.description: The server's problems on the lines that set it, in its words.

set.description: Where the file sets it; `null` when it leaves it out.

table.description: Its table, as a dotted path: `consumer`, or empty for the top level.

value.description:
Its value in the file; `null` when the file leaves it out, or writes
it as something other than a string, a boolean, or a whole number.

SettingPlace.description: Where the file sets a setting.

line.description: The line its key is on, counted from 1, as `ascribe.toml:12` names it.

range.description: From its key to the end of its value.

SettingProblem.description: A problem the server reports on a setting.

message.description: The message, as the Problems panel shows it.

anyOf.description: A string: a choice's, a level's, or a text's.

description:
The answer to `ascribe/settings`. A document that isn't one of the
project's files gets no settings.

modelUri.description:
The `file:` URI of the project's `ascribe.toml`, which the ranges are
in.

settings.description:
Every setting of a simple kind in a table a project doesn't name
(`[project]`, `[consumer]`, `[editor]`, and the rest, not
`[types.<name>]`), in the content model reference's order.

unreadable.description:
Why the file's values can't be read: it isn't valid TOML. `null` when
they can.

version.description:
The version of `ascribe.toml`'s open document the answer was read
from; `null` when it isn't open, and the answer was read from the
disk.

title: SettingsResult
